name: Japan
notes: House of Representatives: 289 single-member constituencies (first-past-the-post) + 176 PR seats in 11 regional blocs (D'Hondt, no threshold). Baseline: the 8 February 2026 snap election (LDP 316 seats, a two-thirds majority). The district tier projects winners by plurality from the 2026 top-two baselines (winner + runner-up shares from the results article - no full candidate lists); the 2026 district result is reproduced exactly when the model is fed the FPTP national shares (LDP 249 / Ishin 20 / DPFP 8 / CRA 7 / independents 5). The PR tier uses per-bloc D'Hondt with a uniform swing from the national PR baseline; the real allocation also reallocates seats forfeited by list exhaustion (not modelled) and the official per-party PR totals are 67/42/20/16/15/11/4/1. The polls are party-support measures (raw, including 'no party'), used as vote proxies. Geometry: the Commons 2024 constituency map (data-name labels; Akita unlabeled and Wakayama-2 typo handled; 2022 reapportionment cuts included). Next election: by February 2030.
